notes: Duplicates: 'Keep copies in these folders first' - a list of folders in order of preference; in each set the copy in the first listed folder is kept (otherwise the best copy). Right-click a copy: 'Keep copies in this folder for every set'. New 'Compare…' plays a copy side by side with the kept one.
Subject Tracker: long videos are made in 1-minute parts - a stopped or interrupted video continues after the last finished part instead of starting again.

Subject Tracker: faster - frames are cropped on several processor cores with fewer copies, and finding subjects decodes and shrinks the video on NVIDIA graphics cards while the AI looks at the previous frame.

Enhance: 'AI denoise only when the video is noisy' - each video is checked and clean ones skip the slow AI denoise. Settings > AI engine: whether the quality levels with AI denoise use it on every video or only on noisy ones.
